🇩🇪 A1 GERMAN VOCABULARY: Tiere (Animals)

der Fisch = fish
das Pferd = horse
die Kuh = cow
das Schaf = sheep
das Schwein = pig
die Maus = mouse

💡 Tip: Learn der/die/das with every noun.
